atlas.name: Yeo 17 resting-state networks (Yeo et al. 2011)
atlas.description: Finer 17-network solution from the same clustering as the 7-network atlas. The original paper does not name the 17 networks, so they are numbered here; several of them subdivide the 7 coarse networks.

reference.text: Yeo BTT et al. (2011). The organization of the human cerebral cortex estimated by intrinsic functional connectivity. J Neurophysiol 106, 1125-1165.

atlas.data_source: fsLR 32k dlabel file from the CBIG GitHub repository (ThomasYeoLab/CBIG).
atlas.note: No curated descriptions; use the Yeo 7 overlap shown for each network.
